Details lead.paragraph: Share a few details and we will come back with product recommendations, brand options and a tailored quotation — usually within one working day.

Field message input.paragraph: Tell us about your project, quantities and timeline…

Privacy note.paragraph: We respect your privacy — no spam, ever.

style.Enquiry: background: #FFFFFF; flex-direction: column; padding: 110px max(40px, calc((100% - 1350px) / 2)) 120px max(40px, calc((100% - 1350px) / 2)); @media(--tablet){ padding: 88px 40px 96px 40px; } @media(--mobile){ padding: 64px 20px 72px 20px; }
style.Enquiry row: padding: 0px; gap: 72px; align-items: flex-start; @media(--tablet){ flex-direction: column; gap: 56px; } @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; gap: 48px; }
style.Details: flex-direction: column; gap: 28px; padding: 0px; width: 440px; min-width: 440px; align-items: flex-start; @media(--tablet){ width: 100%; min-width: 0px; } @media(--mobile){ width: 100%; min-width: 0px; }
style.Details label: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center;
style.Details rule: width: 32px; min-width: 32px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.Details eyebrow: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #C9962E;
style.Details title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 60px; line-height: 62px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: #0B2F62; @media(--tablet){ font-size: 50px; line-height: 54px; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 40px; line-height: 44px; }
style.Details lead: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; line-height: 29px; color: #5F6675;
style.Social chips: padding: 0px; gap: 8px; width: auto; flex-wrap: wrap;
style.Social Instagram: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 10px; line-height: 12px; letter-spacing: 1.6px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0B2F62; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6; transition: border-color 0.3s, color 0.3s; &:hover{ border-color: #C9962E; color: #C9962E; }
style.Social LinkedIn: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 10px; line-height: 12px; letter-spacing: 1.6px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0B2F62; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6; transition: border-color 0.3s, color 0.3s; &:hover{ border-color: #C9962E; color: #C9962E; }
style.Social Facebook: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 10px; line-height: 12px; letter-spacing: 1.6px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0B2F62; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6; transition: border-color 0.3s, color 0.3s; &:hover{ border-color: #C9962E; color: #C9962E; }
style.Social WhatsApp: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 10px; line-height: 12px; letter-spacing: 1.6px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0B2F62; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6; transition: border-color 0.3s, color 0.3s; &:hover{ border-color: #C9962E; color: #C9962E; }
style.Enquiry form: position: relative; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; padding: 56px; flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6; box-shadow: 0px 24px 60px 0px rgba(11,47,98,0.08); @media(--tablet){ width: 100%; flex: 1 1 auto; padding: 48px; } @media(--mobile){ width: 100%; flex: 1 1 auto; padding: 32px 20px; }
style.Form gold bar: position: absolute; top: -1px; left: -1px; right: -1px; width: auto; height: 4px; min-width: 0px; padding: 0px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.Form title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 40px; line-height: 42px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: #0B2F62; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 32px; line-height: 36px; }
style.Form note: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 13px; line-height: 16px; color: #5F6675;
style.Form row 1: padding: 0px; gap: 20px; align-items: flex-start; @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; }
style.Field name: flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 0px; flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px;
style.Field name label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.8px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0B2F62;
style.Field name input: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; line-height: 17px; color: rgba(95,102,117,0.8); background: #FBFAF7; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6; padding: 16px 18px; width: 100%;
style.Field company: flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 0px; flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px;
style.Field company label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.8px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0B2F62;
style.Field company input: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; line-height: 17px; color: rgba(95,102,117,0.8); background: #FBFAF7; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6; padding: 16px 18px; width: 100%;
style.Form row 2: padding: 0px; gap: 20px; align-items: flex-start; @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; }
style.Field email: flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 0px; flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px;
style.Field email label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.8px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0B2F62;
style.Field email input: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; line-height: 17px; color: rgba(95,102,117,0.8); background: #FBFAF7; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6; padding: 16px 18px; width: 100%;
style.Field phone: flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 0px; flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px;
style.Field phone label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.8px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0B2F62;
style.Field phone input: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; line-height: 17px; color: rgba(95,102,117,0.8); background: #FBFAF7; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6; padding: 16px 18px; width: 100%;
style.Interests label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.8px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0B2F62;
style.Chips: padding: 0px; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-start;
style.Chip Chinaware: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; line-height: 15px; padding: 9px 14px; background: #0B2F62; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #0B2F62;
style.Chip Cutlery: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; line-height: 15px; padding: 9px 14px; color: #0B2F62; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6;
style.Chip Glassware: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; line-height: 15px; padding: 9px 14px; color: #0B2F62; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6;
style.Chip Drinkware: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; line-height: 15px; padding: 9px 14px; color: #0B2F62; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6;
style.Chip Melamine: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; line-height: 15px; padding: 9px 14px; color: #0B2F62; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6;
style.Chip Kitchen: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; line-height: 15px; padding: 9px 14px; color: #0B2F62; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6;
style.Chip Buffet: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; line-height: 15px; padding: 9px 14px; background: #0B2F62; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #0B2F62;
style.Chip Bar: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; line-height: 15px; padding: 9px 14px; color: #0B2F62; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6;
style.Chip Trolleys: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; line-height: 15px; padding: 9px 14px; color: #0B2F62; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6;
style.Chip Accessories: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; line-height: 15px; padding: 9px 14px; color: #0B2F62; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6;
style.Chip Lamps: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; line-height: 15px; padding: 9px 14px; color: #0B2F62; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6;
style.Chip Indian: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; line-height: 15px; padding: 9px 14px; color: #0B2F62; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6;
style.Field message: flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 0px; flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px;
style.Field message label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.8px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0B2F62;
style.Field message input: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; line-height: 17px; color: rgba(95,102,117,0.8); background: #FBFAF7; border: 1px solid #E6E0D6; padding: 16px 18px; width: 100%; min-height: 140px;
style.Submit row: padding: 0px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 20px; @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column-reverse; align-items: stretch; }
style.Privacy note: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 12px; line-height: 15px; color: #5F6675;
style.Send enquiry: background: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%); color: #071F44; font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; letter-spacing: 2.2px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 18px 30px; border-radius: 0px; transition: opacity 0.3s; &:hover{ opacity: 0.9; }
